summary: Youlife Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Ms. Liqun Yao, previously a director and Acting CFO, as Chief Financial Officer effective April 29, 2026. Ms. Yao has served in finance roles at the company since 2021 and previously at Shanghai Yuyuan Tourist Mart and PwC. The appointment is described as a routine internal promotion with no terms disclosed, no board recommendation or advisor mentioned. This is a standard management change with no structural or economic implications for shareholders.
